$comment: Codex CLI hooks manifest — the Codex-side safety floor, mirror of the Claude Code PreToolUse hooks wired in ../.claude-plugin/plugin.json. Codex's hook system shares Claude's event names, schema, and exit-code-2-blocks convention, so the same scripts run unchanged. Install: copy this to <project>/.codex/hooks.json (or ~/.codex/hooks.json) and make the void hook scripts resolvable at the referenced path. See ../../../docs/CODEX.md. Matchers list both tool names for the command surface — `Bash` (per the official Codex hooks docs) and `shell` (legacy) — so the floor fires whichever a given Codex build emits; apply_patch is the file-edit tool. Paths use ${VOID_HOOKS_DIR}, resolved from the Git root at run time so a session started in a subdirectory still finds the scripts.
